Density big

Source: R/density.R
get_density_big.Rd

Calculate the nonprofit density metric having resource larger than a numeric value and return a dataframe.

Usage

get_density_big(df, geo, subsector, fips, year, resource, greater.than)

Arguments

df

A dataframe containing the required fields for computing the metric(density) grouped by geographical level and sub sector.

geo

A character string indicating the column name for geographical area unique code.

subsector

A character string indicating the column name for sub sectors.

fips

A character string indicating the column name for FIPS code of the geographical area

year

A numeric parameter indicating the year to be used for population estimate. Example: 1999

resource

A character string indicating the column name for resource based on which density is evaluated

greater.than

A numeric value indicating that it is the lower limit of the resource for density evaluation. All organizations having resource value greater than that would be counted for evaluation.

Value

A new dataframe with the density of nonprofits per 100000 population, having resource greater than the given number grouped by geographical level and sub sectors.

Details

The density metric is the number of nonprofits per-capita in a market. In this function, it is measured as the number of organizations per 100,000 population.

Deprecated

This function uses the legacy NCCS core-file layout and is deprecated.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
get_density_big( nonprofit_sample, 'MSA_NECH', 'NTMAJ12', 'FIPS',
                 2009, 'TOTREV', 100000 )
} # }
